title: Skyscraper balcony
content: I had a dream in mall world by the ocean, there were stands on the sand facing the ocean like bleachers for a soccer game but when the waves would come the people on the bleachers would fall off or float back with the waves. I step out onto the balcony of the skyscraper, i had to be minimum 30 floors up, The floor beneath me is glass and When I look down i realize the hotel/skyscraper is on stilts! the waves were somehow washing in underneath the balcony and hotel. I also noticed a gate in the balcony's railing that you could literally open and walk off to nothing but falling 30 floors down. this is the closest image i can find without the gate and bleachers obviously.
